scope: Create 6.0.8 contraption movement guards: assembly refused while protected positions are captured, disassembly refused when blocks would land on protected positions; no gameplay changes.

create.assemblyGuard: BlockMovementChecks.registerMovementAllowedCheck; protected positions return CheckResult.FAIL, others PASS. Create raises AssemblyException.unmovableBlock during capture, before any block is removed or a moving entity spawns.
create.disassemblyGuard: CreateDisassemblyGuardMixin injects AbstractContraptionEntity.disassemble at HEAD and cancels when any contraption block would be written onto a protected position. Create API is reached by reflection (the shaded catnip libraries are not compile deps); signatures pinned by CreateApiContractTest.
create.optionalRuntime: CreateMovementGuard catches LinkageError; ExpeditionMixinPlugin applies the disassembly mixin only when the Create runtime exists. mods.toml declares create optional [6.0.8,7).
create.remaining: Contraption movement while riding, drill/harvester actor block writes, and real in-game assembly/disassembly around protected devices still require runtime acceptance; the chunk-write guard remains the backstop for any unchecked path.

runtimeAcceptance: Current artifact NOT_RUNTIME_TESTED. No installation to any instance.
notes: Full 89-class test run; definition policy remains 105/125 from the labfinal batch. Formal pools and natural entrances remain closed.
